findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_questions" is 5309 chars, far longer than this server's median (336). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_questions, check_draft · Public sink: get_questions, check_draft, submit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_questions, check_draft · Public sink: get_questions, check_draft, submit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
